race.description: Remembering Rowan Wicks Country Boosted Mdn Plate
race.comment: The big guns have been scratched, leaving us with a very plain maiden. PARTING THE SEAS (3) worked home well but found one better over a similar trip to this at Lismore recently. Rock hard fit after three runs back and from the good draw should get all the favours. APACHE PRANCER (5) is a first starter from the Robert Agnew stable. By Standout from a So You Think mare. Trial form has been ordinary but early markets suggest he will be highly competitive in a field of this calibre. OMAHA BART (2) jumped well but was shuffled back before rallying late to get up for fifth on debut over 1000m at Coffs Harbour recently. With a little natural improvement he should be right in the finish. PRESTIGE BLUE (15) settled worse than midfield and failed to improve first-up over 1000m at Coffs Harbour. Fitter and better placed over this slightly longer trip. From a nice gate ANOTHER BLING (1) can feature first-up from a spell.
